T: No chickens were harmed in the making of this menu.
D: A coop of chickens plan a great escape from a farm before they end up in pies.
P: Serve the pies when Mrs Tweedy fires up the pie machine.
S: the eggs the chickens have to lay to stay alive
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, mashed with mayo, chives and white pepper, on soft white bread with cress, cut into triangles.
the rats who trade smuggled goods for eggs
Cheddar and crackers with pickled onions and apple chutney, the kind of thing a pair of rats might carry in.
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in parmesan and paprika, cut into strips and twisted like yarn, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
M: Mrs Tweedy's pie machine, beef only
Beef chuck braised in ale with onion and thyme for 2.5 hours, thickened, cooled, in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. No chicken, ever.
for the vegetarians in the coop
Leek, mushroom, potato and cheddar in a creamy sauce, under puff pastry, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until golden.
W: a proper British pudding for the flight
Suet or butter pastry spread with raspberry jam, rolled up, wrapped loosely in paper and foil, baked at 180C for 40 minutes. Custard.
K: English breakfast tea brewed strong in a big pot, milk and sugar on the side.

s.note: the eggs the chickens have to lay to stay alive
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chopped chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread, scatter with cress, close and cut into triangles. Serve straight away.

Brush 2 sheets puff pastry with beaten egg and cover one with 80g grated parmesan and a pinch of paprika. Lay the other on top, press, cut into strips and twist. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp.

m.note: Mrs Tweedy's pie machine, beef only
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme and 375ml ale and braise covered for 2.5 hours. Thicken, cool, then fill 4 pie tins lined with shortcrust. Top with puff, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: a proper British pudding for the flight
w.how: Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, then add 150ml cold water to a soft dough. Roll to a rectangle, spread with 150g raspberry jam and roll up. Wrap loosely in baking paper and foil and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with custard.

d.how: Warm a big teapot, add 5 tea bags and 1.2L boiling water and brew 5 minutes so it's properly strong. Pour into four mugs with milk and sugar on the side for everyone to sort out their own.
